data.text: [00:04]Well, it’s very difficult to choose – but I think number three for me is Feelin’ So Good by Jennifer Lopez. I love it!
[00:14.4]It reminds me of when I was at school. `[00:17]We finished our exams and then this song was on the radio all summer. `[00:22]It makes me feel so happy. I always want to dance when I hear it!
[01:31]Great! So number three is Jennifer Lopez, what about number two?

[01:38]Number two for me is something completely different … it’s a piece of classical music. `[01:44]It’s got great memories for me! I heard it first when I was about ten years old and I didn’t know anything about classical music at that time. `[01:54]It’s the fourth movement of Mahler’s Symphony number 5. `[01:59]When I first heard it, it made me cry because it was so beautiful!! `[02:03.8]And I still love it.
[02:05.6]OK … so here it is … the fourth movement of Symphony number 5 by Mahler ...
[02:53]That really is lovely, isn’t it?
[02:57]So, number one … what’s your all-time number one favourite piece of music?

[03:02.9]Well, I think my favourite song ever is Imagine by John Lennon. `[03:08]I think he’s got a fantastic voice. `[03:10.9]It reminds me of a great holiday I had ... . I remember listening to it when I was on the beach in Spain. `[03:17.9]It’s so relaxing – I could listen to it every day!
[04:23.5]A great choice! Thank you for coming in today to tell us about your top three, Mark …
